name: Brambles Limited
summary: Brambles Limited provides supply chain logistics solutions. The company operates through CHEP Americas, CHEP EMEA, and CHEP Asia-Pacific segments. It offers pallets, crates, and containers to transport goods in supply chains through its share and reuse network. The company also provides end-to-end quality assurance, promo insights, and proof of delivery solutions. It serves consumer staples, retail, automotive, and general manufacturing industries. Brambles Limited was founded in 1875 and is based in Sydney, Australia.
